source: 256 genuinely rendered frames of unchanged analytic asymmetric pear, 1.40625 degree steps, encoded 30fps, 8.533333 seconds; not generated-object reconstruction.
heldout_policy: Same four absolute heldout angles as 64-frame control. Fit all other observations, evaluate available heldout observations; pass requires every available heldout error <=3px. Tracks without >=2 training and >=1 heldout observations are unevaluated, not failed.
identity_policy: Same nearest-visible-known-vertex classifier as 64-frame control: every observation must map within 3px; all mapped IDs identical means correct, different IDs means wrong_identity, otherwise unresolved_detection_or_drift. Duplicate pole coordinates canonicalized.
cautions: Analytic control truth and exact cameras are evaluation only; no generated geometry receives them.
Nearest-vertex-within-3px is an operational classifier, not infallible identity ground truth near compressed silhouette vertices.
Denser cadence changes number of samples and span between reseeding events (unchanged seed_every=5).
Reprojection with many nearby training frames is a weak identity test, even for a track with a longer total span.
A track may have only one of the four heldout angles; missing heldout angles do not count as observations.
